hints.cat: Lick a paw and wipe your face, then stretch and arch your back.
hints.dog: Pant with your tongue out, then wag an invisible tail and beg.
hints.octopus: Wave both arms and wiggle all your fingers like eight tentacles.
hints.sloth: Do everything in extreme slow motion, hanging from an imaginary branch.
hints.chameleon: Stand still, roll your eyes in different directions, then shoot out your tongue.
hints.praying mantis: Fold your hands in front of you, stay frozen, then strike suddenly.
hints.flamingo: Stand on one leg with a long curved neck and tuck your head under an arm.
hints.hedgehog: Curl into a tight ball with your arms around your knees, then peek out and shuffle along on tiptoe, flinching at any touch.
hints.jellyfish: Float with soft, floppy arms drifting above your head, pulse your body slowly like a bell, and wiggle your fingers as stinging tentacles.
hints.woodpecker: Cling to an imaginary tree trunk, then bob your head forward again and again very fast, pecking, and cock your head to listen.
hints.elephant: Swing one arm in front of your face like a long trunk, stomp slowly with heavy steps, and flap your hands as big ears.
hints.monkey: Scratch your armpits and head, hop around hunched over, and climb an imaginary tree while chattering your teeth.
hints.snake: Slither your whole body in S curves, hold one hand as a head that darts forward, and flick your tongue in and out.
hints.penguin: Keep your arms stiff by your sides with hands pointing out, waddle with short steps, and slide on your belly.
hints.kangaroo: Hold your hands up in front of your chest like short arms, hop with both feet together in big jumps, and peek into a pouch.
hints.giraffe: Stretch your neck very high with a hand as a head, reach up to nibble leaves from a tall tree, and walk with long, slow steps.
hints.bat: Hang upside down from a branch, wrapped in your arms like wings, then spread them and flutter in the dark.
hints.crab: Make claws with both hands, snap them, and scuttle sideways with bent knees.
hints.fish: Press your palms together and swim, opening and closing your mouth with wide round eyes.
hints.bird: Flap your arms like wings, hop around, and peck at the ground.
hints.cow: Hold two fingers up as horns, chew slowly, then pretend to milk with both hands.
hints.duck: Make a beak with one hand, waddle with your elbows tucked, and flap your wings.
hints.pig: Push your nose up with a finger, waddle on all fours, and roll around in imaginary mud.
hints.frog: Crouch low, puff out your cheeks, and leap forward, flicking your tongue at a fly.
